alerts.description:
Reentrancy in SmartAccount.executeOperation(uint256,uint256,SmartAccount.Action[]) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#113-127):
	External calls:
	- (ok,result) = actions[i].target.call{value: actions[i].value}(actions[i].data) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#122)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- _executing = false (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#125)
	SmartAccount._executing (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#64) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- SmartAccount._completeRecovery(bytes32) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#399-417)
	- SmartAccount.executeOperation(uint256,uint256,SmartAccount.Action[]) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#113-127)

Contract locking ether found:
	Contract Counter (contracts/Counter.sol#5-17) has payable functions:
	 - Counter.increment(uint256) (contracts/Counter.sol#9-12)
	But does not have a function to withdraw the ether

QuotaPaymaster._validatePaymasterUserOp(PackedUserOperation,bytes32,uint256) (contracts/QuotaPaymaster.sol#64-82) ignores return value by (signer,err,None) = ECDSA.tryRecover(sponsorshipDigest(op,until,after_,policyEpoch),signature) (contracts/QuotaPaymaster.sol#71-72)
SmartAccount._thresholdValid(bytes32,bytes) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#190-199) ignores return value by (signer,err,None) = ECDSA.tryRecover(digest,signatures) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#194)

SmartAccount._validateSignature(PackedUserOperation,bytes32) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#149-188) ignores return value by (recovered,err,None) = ECDSA.tryRecover(opHash,signature) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#170)

SmartAccount.executeOperation(uint256,uint256,SmartAccount.Action[]) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#113-127) has external calls inside a loop: (ok,result) = actions[i].target.call{value: actions[i].value}(actions[i].data) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#122)

Reentrancy in SmartAccount.executeOperation(uint256,uint256,SmartAccount.Action[]) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#113-127):
	External calls:
	- (ok,result) = actions[i].target.call{value: actions[i].value}(actions[i].data) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#122)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- Executed(nonce,payload) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#126)

SmartAccount.setSession(address,address,bytes4,uint48,uint256) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#237-248) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- key == address(0) || target == address(this) || target == address(_entryPoint) || target.code.length == 0 || validUntil <= block.timestamp (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#242-243)

SmartAccount._completeRecovery(bytes32) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#399-417) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- _executing || ! proposal.active || proposal.policyEpoch != epoch || proposal.votes < guardianThreshold || block.timestamp < proposal.readyAt (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#402-403)

SmartAccount._spendSession(address,SmartAccount.Action[]) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#227-235) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- s.epoch != epoch || block.timestamp > s.validUntil || ! _sessionAllowed(s,actions) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#229)

SmartAccount._sessionAllowed(SmartAccount.Session,SmartAccount.Action[]) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#210-225) uses assembly
	- INLINE ASM (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#220)

SmartAccount.setOwners(address[],uint256) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#256-270) has costly operations inside a loop:
	- delete owners[_owners[i]] (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#259)

SmartAccount.setGuardians(address[],uint256) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#272-286) has costly operations inside a loop:
	- delete guardians[_guardians[i]] (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#275)

Low level call in SmartAccount.executeOperation(uint256,uint256,SmartAccount.Action[]) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#113-127):
	- (ok,result) = actions[i].target.call{value: actions[i].value}(actions[i].data) (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#122)

AccountFactory.getAddress(address,address,bytes32) (contracts/AccountFactory.sol#15-19) uses literals with too many digits:
	- codeHash = keccak256(bytes)(abi.encodePacked(type()(SmartAccount).creationCode,abi.encode(entryPoint,owner,guardian))) (contracts/AccountFactory.sol#16-17)
Loop condition i < _owners.length (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#407) should use cached array length instead of referencing `length` member of the storage array.
Loop condition i < _owners.length (contracts/SmartAccount.sol#258) should use cached array length instead of referencing `length` member of the storage array.
